title: Review sheet data file
description: The data file a review sheet page renders from, published as sheet.json beside the page. It holds the review's title, one card per call the owner has to make, and a block that depends on the sheet's kind: the remainder block, the final block, or the prSheet block of a sheet for one PR or for a stack of PRs that merges whole, or the index block of the index that lists every PR waiting on the owner. The rules this schema cannot express are: card ids are unique within the sheet; option ids are unique within their card; every id in remainder.unsettled names a card in the sheet; a recommendation's optionId, when present, names one of that card's option ids; stop ids are unique within the walk; row numbers are unique within the index.

schema.description: The name and version of this data format, which is always superheroes-sheet/1.

kind.description: Which sheet this is: a remainder sheet for a review that left findings unsettled, a final sheet for a finished review, a plain sheet with only cards, a pr sheet for one PR, a stack sheet for one sheet over a stack of PRs that merges whole, or an index that lists the questions that block work and every PR waiting on the owner.

title.description: The review's name, shown in the app bar.

remainder.description: The summary of a review that left findings unsettled, present only on a remainder sheet.

fixesMade.description: How many fixes the review made.

unsettled.description: The ids of the cards that hold a finding the review did not settle.

final.description: The summary of a finished review, present only on a final sheet.

history.description: What the review did, in counts and one line about the vet.

fixesMade.description: How many fixes the review made.

vet.description: The vet's outcome in one line.

declinedFindings.description: The findings the review chose not to act on, each with its reason.

items.description: One finding the review declined, with the reason it was declined.

approval.description: Whether the review ended with an approved board and where that board is kept.

approvedBoard.description: True when there is an approved board.

boardSavedWithSpec.description: True when the approved board is saved with the spec.

allOf.description: The board can be saved with the spec only when there is an approved board.

prSheet.description: The summary of one PR, or of a stack of PRs that merges whole, present only on a pr sheet or a stack sheet.

index.description: The list of PRs waiting on the owner, present only on an index.

cards.description: The calls the owner has to make, one card each. A remainder sheet or a plain sheet has at least one; a final sheet, a pr sheet, a stack sheet or an index may have none when there are no calls left.

allOf.description: A remainder sheet must carry the remainder block and must not carry the final block or the prSheet block.
A final sheet must carry the final block and must not carry the remainder block or the prSheet block.
A plain sheet must carry none of the remainder block, the final block and the prSheet block.
A pr sheet must carry the prSheet block, which must not list a stack's PRs, and must carry neither the remainder block nor the final block.
A stack sheet must carry the prSheet block, which must list the stack's PRs, and must carry neither the remainder block nor the final block.
On a pr sheet or a stack sheet, every option says whether picking it sends the PR back for a fix.
A remainder sheet or a plain sheet must have at least one card.
An index must carry the index block and must carry none of the remainder block, the final block and the prSheet block.
Every sheet but an index must not carry the index block.
On an index, every card is a question with options and no option sends anything back.

index.description: The list of PRs waiting on the owner: one row for each, which may be none.

rows.description: The rows of the index, in the order shown within each state.

indexRow.description: One PR, or one stack, on the index, with the counts the row's caption shows.

number.description: The PR's number, or the stack's number.

kind.description: Whether the row is one PR or a stack that merges whole.

title.description: The title of the PR's sheet.

link.description: The link that opens the PR's sheet, which must be an https link.

state.description: Where the PR stands: needs-you when it waits on the owner, being-fixed when it has gone back for a fix, ready when the owner has given a merge verdict.

accepted.description: How many of the sheet's items are accepted.

total.description: How many items the sheet has.

walked.description: How many of the sheet's walk stops have a result.

walkTotal.description: How many walk stops the sheet has.

mergesAt.description: The place of the PR in the merge order, counting from 1, or null when it has none.

caption.description: The line shown under the row's name, composed once when the index is built: what is accepted, what is walked, then where the PR stands. The page and the chat prose show it as it is.

commit.description: A git commit id in lowercase hex, from seven to forty characters.

prSheet.description: What the owner needs to see of one PR, or of a stack of PRs that merges whole: what changed, the craft decisions made, the calls already decided, how the review went, and, when there is something to try, a walk through the change.

number.description: The PR's number on a pr sheet, or the stack's number on a stack sheet.

previousCommit.description: The commit the replaced sheet described, present only on a sheet that replaced one published for an earlier commit of the same PR.

whatChanged.description: What the PR changed and how its review went, in facts.

summary.description: What the PR changes, in plain words.

reviewers.description: The reviewers of the PR, one entry each.

items.description: One reviewer, with where the fact that it ran comes from and whether it was independent of the maker.

family.description: The model family the reviewer is from, or null when the review record could not identify it.

ran.description: Where the fact that the reviewer ran comes from, as the review record writer states it (its ran vocabulary has one home, review_record.RAN_STATES, which the sheet builder validates against).

notIndependent.description: True when the reviewer is from a maker's model family, so its review was not independent. Absent when the review record did not say.

caught.description: What the review caught, one line each.

stoppedAtCap.description: True when the review loop stopped at its round cap.

ci.description: The state of the PR's checks and the commit they ran on.

state.description: The state of the checks in a word or two.

commit.description: The commit the checks ran on, or null when they ran on none.

lane.description: The review lane the PR went through, or null when there is none (the lane vocabulary has one home, review_record.LANES, which the sheet builder validates against).

laneReason.description: Why the PR went through that lane, or null when no reason was given.

craft.description: The craft decisions the maker took, each with the reason for it.

alreadyDecided.description: The calls already decided for the owner, each with the ruling that decided it.

history.description: How the review went, one line each.

walk.description: The walk through the change, absent when the PR has nothing to try.

prs.description: The PRs of the stack, bottom PR first, present only on a stack sheet.

commit.description: The commit the PR is at.

entry.description: One decision, with its title and the words that explain it.

detail.description: The reason for a craft decision, or the ruling that decided the call.

pr.description: On a stack sheet, the number of the PR the decision came from.

walk.description: The part of a PR sheet where the owner tries the change, stop by stop: how to open the product, where the pictures come from, and the stops.

open.description: How to open the product the walk is about.

label.description: The way to open the product, such as Open the test shop.

url.description: A link to the product itself, never to a picture.

detail.description: What else is needed to open it, such as how to sign in.

note.description: The advisor's line under the heading.

picturesFrom.description: Where the walk's pictures come from, in the advisor's words.

stops.description: The stops of the walk, in order.

walkStop.description: One stop of the walk: a try stop is walked by hand, a look stop is a screen that cannot be reached by hand and is only looked at.

key.description: Names the stop's stored answer at walk/<key>; changes when anything the stop shows, or the walk's open or note, changes.

pr.description: The number of the PR the stop belongs to.

group.description: The named group the stop is listed under.

kind.description: A try stop is walked by hand; a look stop is only looked at.

steps.description: The steps of a try stop, in order; empty on a look stop.

expect.description: The Expect line on a try stop, the Look for line on a look stop.

optional.description: True when the stop is not needed for the merge.

notWalked.description: Why the advisor did not walk this stop.

allOf.description: A try stop needs at least one step.
A look stop has no steps.

walkPicture.description: A picture copied into the sheet's own published files, or one that could not be copied and shows as missing; neither names another page.

id.description: A short lowercase identifier made of letters, digits and hyphens that starts with a letter or digit.

answer.description: The document a review sheet page stores for one card, in the sheet's own store. The collection is answers, with one document per card id at answers/<card id>, and each document is written whole on every change. The owner's last tap counts, and the answer is null when nothing is picked: a note saved before any pick, or a pick cleared by tapping it again. This is not part of the data file: no property of the sheet refers to it, and the page reads its answer choices from it. An answer the card does not offer now (aligned or discuss on a card with options, or option or something-else on a card without; accept on any sheet but a pr sheet or a stack sheet; aligned on a pr sheet or a stack sheet) counts as unanswered.

What the owner tapped. On a card with options: option for a pick of one of the card's options, or something-else for Something else, which leaves the call open for chat. On a card without options: aligned or discuss, or on a pr sheet or a stack sheet accept or discuss. Accept is offered only by a pr sheet or a stack sheet. Null when nothing is picked (none yet, or a pick cleared by tapping it again).

optionId.description: The id of the picked option, or null. It is a string exactly when the answer is option.

note.description: The owner's note on the card, an empty string when there is none.

revision.description: A fresh random value written with every save on a pr sheet or a stack sheet, so a Merge can name exactly the answers it was given for; other sheets never write it.

allOf.description: An answer of option must name the picked option.
An answer other than option must not name an option.

walkAnswer.description: The document a PR sheet stores for one walk stop, at walk/<stop key> in the sheet's own store. Each document is written whole on every change and the owner's last tap counts. Works is offered on a try stop and Looks right on a look stop; the other counts as unanswered. A fix is chosen only on a Problem. This is not part of the data file: no property of the sheet refers to it.

answer.description: What the owner tapped, or null when nothing is picked.

fix.description: What should happen with a Problem, or null: an id from walkFixes in sheet-words.json, the one home of the ids; the page restores only an id it offers.

note.description: What the owner saw, an empty string when there is no note.

shots.description: The asset ids of the screenshots the owner added.

allOf.description: A fix is chosen only on a Problem.

verdict.description: The document a final sheet stores at verdict/<digest>, one per sheet revision, saved the moment the owner taps Approve or Not yet (a final sheet) or Merge or Not yet (a pr sheet or a stack sheet) or pauses typing the note, the same way an answer is saved: every save writes the whole document and the last write counts. <digest> is the SHA-256, in lowercase hex, of the exact bytes of the published sheet.json and equals the sheet field, so a republished sheet starts unsigned and a page showing an older revision never touches a newer one. A null verdict (a note saved before any pick, or a verdict cleared by tapping it again) is unanswered. It never counts as approval on its own: the owner's word in the chat does. This is not part of the data file: no property of the sheet refers to it.

What the owner has tapped so far: approve the spec (a final sheet only), merge the PR or the stack (a pr sheet or a stack sheet only), not yet, or null when nothing is picked (only a note was saved, or the pick was cleared by tapping it again).

note.description: The owner's note with the verdict, an empty string when there is none.

sheet.description: The sheet revision this verdict belongs to: the SHA-256, in lowercase hex, of the exact bytes of the published sheet.json as the page fetched them. It equals <digest> in the document's path. A document whose digest differs from the current file's is not a verdict on this sheet.

covers.description: On a pr sheet or a stack sheet, the answers a Merge was given for, one answers/<card id>@<revision> for each card. A Merge whose covers differs from the card answers the store holds now is not a Merge.

allOf.description: A Merge must name the answers it was given for.

verdictsByKind.description: Which verdicts each kind of sheet offers on its last card, in button order, by the sheet's kind. The page builds its verdict buttons from this list and restores a stored verdict only when its own kind offers it; a stored verdict outside its kind's list restores only its note. A remainder sheet or a plain sheet has no verdict. This is not part of the data file: no property of the sheet refers to it.

walkAnswersByKind.description: Which answers each kind of walk stop offers, in button order, by the stop's kind: the one home of that list. The page builds a stop's answer buttons from it and restores a stored answer only when the stop's own kind offers it, the chat prose lists the same answers, and the sheet builder counts a stored answer only when the stop's kind offers it. The words on the buttons are in sheet-words.json. A schema without this definition leaves the walk's answers off. This is not part of the data file: no property of the sheet refers to it.

card.description: One call the owner has to make, with the question, the context the sending session writes, and the options and recommendation if there are any.

id.description: The card's identifier, unique within the sheet and kept the same across republishes so saved answers still match.

callKind.description: The kind of call in plain words, shown on the card's badge.

warning.description: True for the red warning badge: a gap the reviewer found, a statement with no source, or a finding the review did not settle.

question.description: The question the owner is asked, in one line.

context.description: What the owner needs to know to answer, in sections the sending session titles and writes in its own words: paragraphs, bulleted lists, and a quote of the exact text the call is about where there is one. No heading is fixed and no section is required.

images.description: Pictures that help the owner answer, which may be empty.

options.description: The choices the owner can pick from, which may be empty when the call has no fixed choices.

section.description: One part of a card's context: a heading in the sending session's words, then its paragraphs, bulleted lists and quotes, in reading order.

title.description: The section's heading, in the sending session's words.

blocks.description: The section's content, in reading order.

block.description: One piece of a section: a paragraph, a bulleted list, or a quote of exact text. Each block holds exactly one of the three.

bullets.description: A bulleted list, one string per item.

quote.description: The exact text the call is about, quoted as written.

image.description: One picture shown on a card.

src.description: Where the picture is, either a path published with the sheet or a URL.

alt.description: A plain-words description of the picture for people who cannot see it.

caption.description: A short line shown under the picture.

option.description: One choice the owner can pick on a card.

id.description: The option's identifier, unique within its card.

label.description: The option's name as the owner sees it.

consequence.description: The plain consequence of picking this option.

sendsBack.description: True when picking this option sends the PR back for a fix before it merges. A pr sheet or a stack sheet says so on every option; other sheets may leave it out.

recommendation.description: What the review recommends for a card, which a card may leave out.

optionId.description: The id of the option this recommends, which must be one of the same card's option ids.
